title: Deformation Theorem (Simon Ch. 6, 5.1/5.3) for compactly supported IM currents with IM boundary, in codimension ≥ 1
statement: Assume (SL) the exact frozen statement of dor_lmb_slicing_lipschitz (a dependency of the parent node), taken as an antecedent: assuming (C1), for every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by an IMRep RT = (M, θ, ξ), every IMRep RB = (M', θ', ξ') representing ∂T and every L-Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ, there are P_t ∈ 𝒟_k(U) (t ∈ ℝ) such that (1) for every open W, t ↦ M_W(P_t) is a.e.-measurable and ∫_ℝ M_W(P_t) dt ≤ L·M_W(T); (2) for L¹-a.e. t: P_t is IM, P_t(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from f⁻¹(t), and P_t(ω) = ∫_{M∩{f<t}} θ⟨dω, ξ⟩ dH^{k+1} − ∫_{M'∩{f<t}} θ'⟨ω, ξ'⟩ dH^k for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U). Conventions: ℝ^P = Euclid P and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. For U ⊆ ℝ^P, 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms on ℝ^P with compact support contained in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary (∂X(ω) = X(dω)); X − Y is the contract subtraction (pointwise on test forms). For G ⊆ ℝ^P, M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of max(X(ω), 0) over ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and |ω(x)| ≤ 1 for all x, where |·| is the Euclidean coefficient norm of covectors (covectorEuclideanNorm); M(X) = X.mass = M_U(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) in U is the contract structure IMRep U d; R represents X when X(ω) = ∫_M θ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dHᵈ for every ω ∈ 𝒟^d(U), where ⟨ω, ξ⟩(x) = ξ(x)(ω(x)); μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M is R.measure; X is integer multiplicity (IM, IsIntegerMultiplicity X) if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off a set K if X(ω) = 0 for every ω whose tsupport is disjoint from K. X_j ⇀ Y (WeaklyConvergesOn) means X_j(ω) → Y(ω) for every ω. V ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContained V U) means that closure V is compact and contained in U. Let P, m ∈ ℕ with n := m + 1 < P. There is c ≥ 0 such that for every ρ > 0, every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P and every IM T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (domain univ) with ∂T IM and T vanishing off K, there are a finite set s of pairs p = (z_p, ι_p) ∈ ℤ^P × (Fin n → Fin P) with ι_p strictly increasing, integers β_p (a function β on such pairs) and currents Π ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), R ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P), S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) such that: Π(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} β_p ∫_{F_p} ω(x)(e_{ι_p(0)}, …, e_{ι_p(m)}) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), where e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and F_p := {x : ρz_{p,i} ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_{p,i} + 1) for i ∈ range ι_p, x_i = ρz_{p,i} otherwise} is the closed n-face ρ(z_p + F_{ι_p}) of the cubical grid of side ρ (Simon's 𝓛_n(ρ); the same cells as latticeFace in the project's GMT/Ch06/Contract.lean), oriented by e_{ι_p(0)}∧⋯∧e_{ι_p(m)}; R and S are IM; T − Π = ∂R + S; (Σ_{p∈s}|β_p|)·ρⁿ ≤ c·M(T), M(R) ≤ cρ·M(T) and M(S) ≤ cρ·M(∂T) (in [0, ∞]); F_p ⊆ cthickening(2√P·ρ, K) for every p ∈ s; and R and S vanish off cthickening(2√P·ρ, K). This is Simon's Deformation Theorem 5.3 (5.1 when ρ = 1) for IM T with IM ∂T and compact support, with M(Π) = (Σ_{p∈s}|β_p|)ρⁿ.
